title: Onboarding & polish fixes
notes: The “Brand your community” and “Set your app icon” onboarding steps now complete correctly. The Invite friends button no longer shows a literal {n}. Add-on footer links (RSS, privacy choices) now sit in a tidy centered footer.

changelog.text: “Brand your community” and “Set your app icon” getting-started steps now tick off once done.
The “Send invites” button showed a literal {n} instead of the count.
Add-on footer links (RSS, privacy choices) now sit in a tidy centered footer.
